items.description: LibreTube 是免费开源的安卓 YouTube 第三方前端，不用注册谷歌账号、不用装谷歌服务就能看油管，还自带去广告、SponsorBlock 跳过赞助片段、ReturnYouTubeDislike、后台播放和下载功能。它可以走 Piped 中转加载数据和同步订阅、播放列表，订阅和列表都存在手机本地，隐私性比官方客户端好得多。下载走 F-Droid 或 GitHub 官方发布页，装 F-Droid 客户端最省事，能自动收到更新提醒。注意：它完全依赖油管那边的接口，油管一改规则就可能出现播不了、播放列表为空，要等官方发新版修复（32.1 就是修了这类问题的版本），别装来路不明的修改版。
items.descriptionOriginal: Alternative frontend for YouTube with focus on privacy

items.description: Joplin 是开源的 Markdown 笔记和待办应用，笔记按笔记本分好类，支持待办打勾、附件和插件，手机电脑都能用。去 F-Droid（net.cozic.joplin）或 Google Play 安装，打开就能离线写笔记；想多设备同步就去设置里接自己的 Nextcloud、Dropbox、OneDrive 或 WebDAV，打开端到端加密后连服务商也看不到内容。注意：F-Droid 版更新滞后（最新是 9 月 11 日的 3.7.8），而且没有相机和定位功能，着急用新版走 Google Play 或官网；同步要自己有网盘或服务器，官方的 Joplin Cloud 同步服务是付费的。

items.description: Fossify Gallery 是开源的本地相册，看照片视频、裁剪旋转加滤镜、按文件夹时间整理都能做，最关键是完全不联网，连上网权限都没要，照片不会偷偷上传。去 F-Droid 搜 org.fossify.gallery 安装，或去 Google Play / GitHub 下载；装好给存储权限就能直接浏览手机里的照片，还能一键去掉照片里的 GPS 位置等 EXIF 信息、给相册上 PIN 或指纹锁。注意：它没有任何云备份功能，删掉的照片只在回收站里待一阵子，过期就真没了，重要照片要自己另外备份；大图编辑时很占内存，超大 RAW 图可能被系统杀掉。
items.descriptionOriginal: Gallery with Photo editor. No Ads, Open-source, Private. No strings attached.
items.name: Fossify Gallery
items.summary: 不联网、不上传的本地相册，看图修图够用还护隐私，就是没有云备份。
items.warning: 无云备份功能，删除照片过期后无法恢复，重要照片需自行备份；隐藏文件夹只是不显示，并未加密。

items.description: Bitwarden 是免费开源的密码管理器，能帮你生成、保存和自动填充高强度密码和通行密钥（Passkey），密码存在端到端加密的保险库里，在手机、电脑、浏览器之间同步。免费版就能无限存密码、无限设备同步、无广告，完全够个人用；付费高级版才有 TOTP 验证码、1GB 加密文件等附加功能。下载走 Google Play 或官方 F-Droid 仓库，也能从 GitHub 官方仓库拿 APK，注册账号后设一个主密码就能用，浏览器插件和手机 App 用同一个账号。注意：主密码是唯一钥匙，忘了就谁也帮你找回不了，一定要记牢或抄在安全的地方；另外 2026 年 10 月官方宣布商店上架的将改为商业许可构建，想要开源构建请走 F-Droid 等其他官方渠道。

items.description: Thunderbird for Android 是免费开源的安卓邮箱客户端，由老牌开源邮箱 K-9 Mail 演变而来，能在一个 App 里管多个邮箱账号，支持统一收件箱，兼容 Gmail、Outlook、雅虎、iCloud 等几乎所有支持 IMAP 或 POP3 的邮箱。它没有广告、不拿你的私人数据做买卖，支持 OpenPGP 加密邮件（需另装 OpenKeychain），还能从 K-9 Mail 或桌面版雷鸟扫码导入设置。下载走 Google Play、F-Droid 或 GitHub 官方发布页，装好后输邮箱地址按提示登录就行，一个渠道装的就别换渠道更新，签名不同装不上。注意：它不是桌面版雷鸟的完整移植，邮件筛选等高级功能手机版还没有；K-9 Mail 本体也还在更新，用惯了老版可以不换。

items.description: Obtainium 是开源免费的应用更新管家，专门盯着 GitHub、GitLab、F-Droid 等官方发布页，有新版就提醒你下载安装，适合管那些不上应用商店的开源应用。它自己不是应用商店，不托管安装包，你把应用的官方发布页链接贴进去，它就帮你盯更新。下载办法是去 GitHub Releases 下 APK（分普通版和 F-Droid 版，包名不同别混装），或从 F-Droid 装 F-Droid 版；装好后点添加、贴上目标应用的 GitHub 仓库地址就能开始盯。注意只贴官方发布页链接，别贴来路不明的 APK 链接；它靠抓取网页盯更新，个别源改版时会暂时失效。

items.description: liyuzhou79-star/TuxunXiangqi 是 GitHub 上的一个开源手机应用。将！— 免费开源象棋 App：Pikafish 引擎、AI 一选推荐与形势判断，完全开源（GPL-3.0） 免费开源的中国象棋 App，基于 Pikafish 引擎。 「将！」是一款完全免费、开源的象棋应用，全部功能都在手机本地运行： - 强力引擎对弈：内置 Pikafish（开源象棋引擎，GPL-3.0），三档棋力加 1–10 棋力细调，还可以让它一马、双马甚至车马炮；全部计算在本地完成，不联网、不上传棋局 - AI 表演赛：两台引擎自弈对打，可暂停、可调速，适合观摩高手过招 - 多候选分析：一键给出前四个候选着法、各自的形势判断（胜率与优势）和后续变化，点哪个就在棋盘上标哪个；每个候选还能「试走这条线」——把引擎的变化一步步摆到棋盘上慢慢看（只是预览，不会真的落子，正式走子自动退出）；开局阶段还会给出内置开局库（48 个定式节点）的走法建议 - 局内走势：对局中自动记录每一手的形势分数，连成曲线，哪几手翻盘一目了然 - 摆棋编辑：自己摆任意局面（残局、名局、卡住的棋），从那里开始对弈或分析 - 落点安危提示：选中棋子，落点立刻分安危——绿点安全、红点送死，能吃的子绿圈表示吃完安全、没标记表示会被反吃；本地规则即时判断，设置里可关 - 吃子展示：棋盘下方列出双方已吃掉的子和子力优劣；将军时被将的将/帅有红色脉冲环提醒 - 棋钟与礼仪：可选棋钟（超时判负、最后 10 秒每秒滴答提醒）、认输、求和（引擎只在不占优时同意）、悔棋 - 棋谱库与复盘：对局结束自动存谱，可搜索、筛选、改名；复盘能逐步回放、长按连跳、自动播放，还有每手形势、双方吃子展示、走势图（当前步在图上有圈标记）、关键手巡览、「和引擎一选对比」，以及整局分析（引擎逐手评分、自动标出疑问手与失误手并存回棋谱） - 导入导出：棋谱可导出为文本或文件，也能粘贴/选文件导回来，换手机不丢棋 - 局面图分享：对局中一键把当。它主要用来在安卓手机上完成它擅长的事，免费又没广告打扰。适合安卓手机用户。

items.descriptionOriginal: Amber: Nostr event signer for Android Amber is a nostr event signer for Android. It allows users to keep their nsec segregated in a single, dedicated app. The goal of Amber is to have your smartphone act as a NIP-46 signing device without any need for servers or additional hardware. "Private keys should be exposed to as few systems as possible as each system adds to the attack surface," as the rationale of said NIP states. In addition to native apps, Amber aims to support all current nostr web applications without requiring any extensions or web servers. Amber also runs on Windows, macOS and Linux as a NIP-46 signer built with Compose for Desktop. It supports the same accounts, permissions and bunker connections as the Android app (minus NIP-55, which is Android-only IPC). See desktop/README.md for build and usage instructions.
items.name: greenart7c3/Amber

items.descriptionOriginal: You capture. Kairos decides. A to-do list that sorts itself and tells you what to do now: agile + to-do + GTD, with on-device machine learning that learns how long your tasks really take. No account, no ads, no network. The right time for every task. Kairos answers a concrete question: "what do I do now, and in what order, given that a meeting from 1 pm to 2 pm keeps me from handling the urgent topic before 2:05 pm?" It sorts your tasks into the order to do them, fits them into the gaps of your day, and uses on-device machine learning to learn how long they really take. No account, no ads, no tracking: your data stays on your device. The only network use is the optional online calendar connections, off by default. Android, Windows, Linux, macOS, and in the browser. More options on the download page

items.descriptionOriginal: 🔥 PlainApp is an open-source app that lets you securely manage your phone from a web browser. Access files, media, contacts, SMS, calls, and more through a simple, easy-to-use interface on your desktop. PlainApp is a free, open-source Android app that turns your phone into a self-hosted management hub you can access from any web browser on the same network — no accounts, no cloud, no subscriptions. Whether you need to transfer files, read SMS, browse photos, or mirror your screen, PlainApp puts full control back in your hands. Most phone-management tools either route your data through their own servers, lock features behind subscriptions, or plague you with ads. PlainApp is different: - 100% local — your data never leaves your network - End-to-end encrypted — every connection is secured with TLS + XChaCha20-Poly1305 - Completely free and ad-free — no purchases, no upsells, ever - Fully open-source — audit the code, build your own binary, or contribute

items.descriptionOriginal: Open-source Farcaster client in the browser, with iPhone and Android apps, that talks straight to Quilibrium's Hypersnap network Quilcast is an open-source Farcaster client that runs in the browser, with apps for iPhone and Android. It talks straight to Hypersnap, the Farcaster network that Quilibrium runs, rather than through a hosted API, and your signing keys stay in your own browser (unless you turn on X crossposting, which posts with a key of its own kept on our server). Reads hit the public node's HTTP API, writes are protobuf messages signed in the browser and posted to /v1/submitMessage, and keys live in the browser's IndexedDB, never in localStorage. Do not edit directly — changes will be overwritten. This repository holds a buildable snapshot of the Android/Gradle project for OmniMorse, regenerated automatically whenever a new release is published in the main repo. It exists to give F-Droid (and any other build system that wants a plain Gradle project) a source tree that builds with standard tools: the generated android/ project (output of expo prebuild) is committed here, dependencies are installed at build time with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile (pinned by the committed pnpm-lock.yaml), and .npmrc sets node-linker=hoisted so nodemodules comes out flat and symlink-free — required for F-Droid's source scanner, which resolves real paths.

items.descriptionOriginal: Implementation, configuration, and performance evaluation of a low-cost HPC cluster built from repurposed ARM-based TV Boxes using MPI and NAS Parallel Benchmarks. Análise de Desempenho e Custo de um Cluster de Baixo Custo Baseado em TV Boxes Reaproveitadas Material complementar ao Trabalho de Conclusão de Curso em Ciência da Computação da Universidade Federal de Lavras (UFLA), orientado pelo Prof. Dr. Luiz Henrique Andrade Correia. A pesquisa avalia o desempenho e o custo de um cluster de baixo custo construído com TV Boxes reaproveitadas para computação paralela e distribuída. O cluster reúne nove TV Boxes H7 disponibilizadas pelo CRC-Lavras. Cada unidade tem quatro núcleos ARM Cortex-A55 (AArch64) e cerca de 2 GB de RAM. O server coordena o cluster e executa MPI com node1 a node7, totalizando 32 núcleos. O equipamento nfs serve o armazenamento compartilhado via NFSv3. Os enlaces Ethernet negociaram a 100 Mbit/s em full-duplex. Arquitetura · Hardware

The box's 3.10 vendor kernel stays: NAND, WiFi and the T2 tuner have no mainline drivers. A custom initramfs boots Debian from an image file on the data partition, and everything Android did is done again in Linux (programs of this repository's own, in Python and C). - Television (DVB-T2 and cable DVB-C): channel scans, favourites, the guide, recording to USB, timeshift (pausing live TV), timers, subtitles, teletext, radio, parental lock. items.description: liucz000/tvbox-hub 是 GitHub 上的一个开源成人内容来源。把多个 TVBox / 影视仓配置源聚合成一份可直接订阅的配置，同时输出聚合直播源，支持 Cloudflare Worker 与 Docker / 本地 Node 两种部署方式。 聚合思路参考了 tvbox-ysc-config、tvbox-hub、tvbox-feed、tvbox-source、tvbox-source-aggregator 等项目的优点，代码为独立实现。仅用于技术学习，配置内容均来自公开第三方源，请自行判断合规性。 - 多源聚合：内置 20 个配置源（37 条入口地址，含失效镜像自动回退）+ 18 个直播源；支持多仓配置（urls）递归展开（最多 2 层、15 个子源） - 站点去重与改名：同 key 不同 api 的站点自动改名为 key2、key3；解析按 urltype、直播按 typeurl 去重 - Spider 智能分配：按引用次数投票选一个全局 spider，为自带不同 JAR 的 type:3 站点单独挂 site.jar，避免 JAR 冲突导致站点全部失效 - JAR 反代：配置里的 JAR 统一改写为 ${BASE}/jar/ ，由服务端代理拉取（内存 LRU + Cache API），客户端只需访问本服务 - 直播频道级合并：抓取 M3U / DIYP TXT，按「分组 → 频道」合并多线路，输出 /live.m3u、/live.txt、/live.json - 容错解析：兼容 BOM、行/块注释、尾逗号、JSONP、裸 JSON 片段等常见「脏」配置 - 可选探活：off / shallow / deep 三档，非 off 时对站点做轻量校验，存活率低于 10% 时自动放弃过滤（防误杀） - 无状态两种后端：Worker 用 KV，Node 用 JSON 文件（临时文件 + rename，串行落盘） - 安全默认值：管理接口 fa。它主要用来免费看成人内容，解决到处找入口的问题。适合有这类需求的成年人。

items.descriptionOriginal: Reuso de um aparelho TvBox para ser utilizado por órgãos públicos ou entidades sem fins lucrativos. Agendamento — TV Box Armbian (linux/arm64) Servidor Go + SQLite para registrar os agendamentos do dia (nome, telefone, CEP, médico e selfie). Pensado para rodar na própria TV Box (Armbian aarch64): a TV exibe o QR Code e a fila ao vivo, e os pacientes preenchem o formulário pelo celular, na mesma rede Wi-Fi. O binário é autocontido e não usa CGO — o SQLite é o modernc.org/sqlite, escrito em Go puro —, então o cross-compile a partir do Windows ou de qualquer Linux funciona sem toolchain ARM.
